snippet.title: Awkward Family Dinners With Furry Critters (TRAILER)
snippet.description:
You and your girlfriend are about to dine with her cousin Samantha and her boyfriend. But things go awry.

A game based on real conversations. One part of this game is pretty much entirely fictional, although the dialogue in that scene is pretty much a collage of things and attitudes I heard over the years.

Download on itch.io for Windows, Mac and Linux: https://bruneiros.itch.io/awkward-family-dinners-with-furry-critters
